messages:
Aisha: quick one — can we capture feature asks / onboarding pain points from this week's pilot calls into a single list? need to hand to product tomorrow for prioritization (include renewal risk if customer mentioned it)
Tom: on it. i'll pull call notes from Monday + Wed pilots. do we have a preferred format?
Lena: thanks — short CSV or a simple table in the thread works. columns: customer, ask, impact (low/med/high), renewal_risk (yes/no/unclear), example quote, contact.
Victor: +1. can i take the enablement angle and add whether ask requires docs/train/cs-runbook?
Aisha: please do. add a quick `time-to-deliver` ballpark too (days/weeks). aim for one-line entries so product can scan fast :eyes:
Tom: pasted raw notes below from Acme pilot — will clean into rows later:
```
- Acme: onboarding latency confusing, customer expected model to be pre-warmed. "latency spikes kill demo" -> high impact, renewal risk mentioned
- Zephyr: wants per-route billing toggle so finance can isolate costs -> medium impact, unclear renewal risk
- Helix: can't upload >10k rows to batch importer, fails with 413. workaround manual chunking. -> high impact, renewal at-risk
```
Lena: perfect — i'll review and flag anything that looks like a blocker for the current quarter. can you add the specific API routes / example logs if available (helps engineering estimate)?
Tom: i'll attach logs for Helix and note the endpoint `/v1/uploads/batch` + paste sample error.
Victor: logging a quick enablement note for Zephyr: we can ship a playbook that explains current per-route cost visibility + interim workaround. I'll mark as docs-first.
prod-bot: REMINDER: weekly product sync at 10am PT tomorrow — add this list to backlog pre-read. :clipboard:
Aisha: action items: Tom cleans and posts CSV by EOD, Victor adds enablement column, Lena does quick triage + flags quarter blockers. i'll assemble final digest and ping @product for the sync.
Lena: if anything is obviously engineering-blocking, i'll call it out with "needs immediate triage" label.
Tom: CSV posted: <link to internal drive> — 8 rows. included quotes and contact emails.
Aisha: lovely. final ask: everyone add an estimated customer-visible impact score 1-5 in the CSV. helps prioritize renewal risk.
Victor: added impact scores + runbook notes. put Zephyr as docs-first, Helix as engineering blocker.
Lena: triage done — flagged Helix as "needs immediate triage" and Acme as "high priority but ops workaround exists". queued Zephyr for docs sprint.
Aisha: thanks team — i'll deliver the digest to product and ask for an initial estimate tomorrow. will loop back with outcomes here. :rocket:
Tom: thx — i'll follow up with Helix contact re: logs if product needs more info.
Victor: i'll prepare a one-pager for customer-facing enablement for Zephyr.
Aisha: closing loop once product responds. if anyone adds more rows, please annotate with call timestamp and link to recording.
Lena: noted. good capture.
prod-bot: Product backlog updated with 3 new items from this thread.
